question.text: Mr. Karthik Iyer, a first-time LP, asks you about the scale of the Indian AIF industry today. Based on the current SEBI data referenced in Chapter 6, which of the following is the CORRECT approximate scale of cumulative commitments raised across all registered AIFs?

answer.text: Approximately INR 15.05 lakh crore as of September 30, 2025
Approximately INR 1.5 lakh crore as of September 30, 2025
Approximately INR 50 lakh crore as of September 30, 2025
Approximately INR 150 lakh crore as of September 30, 2025

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states: "Capital commitments raised by all registered AIFs (across categories) have surpassed INR 15.05 lakh crores as on September 30, 2025." As of January 14, 2026, 1,750 AIFs were registered with SEBI, up from just 21 in 2012 — Option A captures the correct, source-current figure. The Trap: Option B (INR 1.5 lakh crore) is off by 10x — tempting if the candidate misreads the decimal. Option D (INR 150 lakh crore) is 10x too large. Option C (INR 50 lakh crore) is fabricated to resemble a plausible "big number". Note: The earlier trap commentary incorrectly labelled Option A as the INR 1.5 lakh crore distractor even though Option A is the correct INR 15.05 lakh crore answer. The labels have been corrected. Because the market-size figure is source-date-specific and volatile, this item should be re-checked whenever a new workbook edition is issued.
